title: The hunger strikes
summary: Sources on the prison hunger strikes, custody conditions and reported bail decisions.
review_note: Health, custody and bail descriptions are dated reporting from the imported dossier. They should not be read as statements of any individual’s current health or detention status.
body_html:
Eight remand prisoners from the Filton and RAF Brize Norton cases began an open-ended hunger strike on 2 November 2025 — the largest in UK prisons since 1981. Four refused food for up to 73 days. Their demands included bail, an end to correspondence censorship, the right to a fair trial, dropping the terrorist-connection claim, de-proscription, and the closure of Elbit’s UK operations. Bail was granted on 20 February 2026. The Justice Secretary declined throughout to meet their representatives.

  • Four Palestine Action Hunger Strikers Finally Granted Bail Novara Media · 20 February 2026 Left novaramedia.com/2026/02/20/four-palestine-action-hunger-strikers-granted-bail/
